description.value: Beach Gardens Resort & Marina is a full-service oceanfront resort and 55-slip marina in Powell River on BC's Sunshine Coast, offering private-patio guest rooms with views of Malaspina Strait. The property hosts the award-winning Seasider Bistro + Wine Bar + Patio, an on-site Cold Beer & Wine Store, the Salish Sea Spirits Distillery, and a fitness centre, all steps from the water. Its combination of resort lodging, a working fuel dock, and a complimentary shuttle to Town Centre Mall makes it a well-equipped base for touring cyclists exploring the northern Sunshine Coast.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and corroborates all OSM contact details (address, phone, website URL). The site confirms the resort is actively operating with a 24/7 front desk and a 2025 copyright notice; it lists coin laundry and free WiFi as confirmed amenities. No mention of bike-specific storage, bike procedures, e-bike charging, or cycling infrastructure appears anywhere on the site.
